voice_facts.basis: units beneath core claims, counted over speech fragments only; unattributed speech is excluded, not imputed

bounds.resolution_basis: The paper analyzes an ongoing identification-management process rather than a bounded episode that becomes settled; its conclusion closes the argument analytically but does not report a temporal resolution of the process.
bounds.why: no resolution_period declared; only the start boundary is testable

voice_rule.rule: a fragment coded voice author_insight never counts as with or against (SCHEMA_v5.md; applied before v5, from 27 Sep 2026)

construct_inversion.differs_in: The first pathway loses the need to seek change and ends in detachment; the second retains aspiration but loses organizational sensegiving and ends in opposition.
The former distributor reports failed support and disenchantment, whereas the inactive distributor reports durable support despite weak participation.
The first episode strengthens reliance on organizational interpretation, while the second produces immediate distancing from the organization.
construct_inversion.note: analyst-constructed pair: a weaker licence than one the authors drew
